Pope Leo Unveils Fresco at Sanctuary Where He Prayed Post-Election

Pope Leo visited the sanctuary in Genazzano where he had prayed following his election. During his visit, he unveiled a new fresco that depicts the event of him praying at the sanctuary after his election. The fresco was created to commemorate his visit and prayer at the location.
